summary: Explain Fractal kit play readiness with lifecycle and unchanged a11y-step timings, phase distributions, slow cases, story-family totals and filter benchmark margins; publish web lane costs as a public check annotation.

replay.detail: CI observability only; no runtime replay change.

schema.detail: No database or protocol schema change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Same play cases, assertions, accessibility rules, shard assignment and isolation; only timing receipts and their publication change.

manual.detail: No manual step. Web-specific runner-seconds SLOs require a new observer series and API support, not an unfed target.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the extra timing observations and public cost table; no live state to recover.
